summary: Recruiter Hub feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (auth 401s, /me summary+recruits+jobs, empty account, alltime/city boards, no-city, invalid scope 422, limit clamp). Frontend (desktop 1920): logged-out /recruiter/hub -> /signin?next=%2Frecruiter%2Fhub; nav trophy nav-recruiter-hub visible and navigates; stats 2/1/1/$0.10; recruits Jamie Worker Smith (Worker, 1 job) and Riley Customer (Customer, 0); expand shows 'Deliver groceries to Park Slope | Oct 20, 2026 | $100.00 | +$0.10'; month tab renders recruiter-leaderboard-public; all-time board shows 'Hub R. YOU' highlighted; city tab shows NEW YORK with own row; /recruiter has recruiter-open-hub link to hub; customer.demo shows hub-recruits-empty and hub-board-no-city. No page errors.

minor.issue: _board loads every referred user + all referral_earnings + orders on each request (no cache/pagination) - will get slow as users grow. Consider caching or a precomputed aggregate.

_jobs_for(all_ids) is called without referrer_id, so if multi-tier referral_earnings rows exist (same source_user_id, different referrer), crew job counts on the board may be inflated vs /me which filters by referrer_id.

issues: 'active recruits' label wraps to two lines in w-20 column, so row heights don't match the other columns
Ranks 1-3 show only a medal icon, no number; masked names can collide (two 'Customer A.' rows), which makes the board confusing

action_items: Optional: cache or precompute leaderboard aggregation
Optional: filter board earnings by referrer to match /me semantics
Optional: widen stat columns / show rank number alongside medal
critical_code_review_comments: HubLeaderboards receives a city prop from RecruiterHub but ignores it (dead prop)
RecruiterHub fetch has no retry and swallows the error detail; acceptable
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recruiter hub tests in /app/backend/tests/test_recruiter_hub.py rely on hubrec_8359b7@lumo.test seeded in Mongo (2 recruits, 1 earning $0.10, city New York).
